blocks.text: The busiest week of the year for U.S. travel is getting off to a bumpy start. Technology failures — including one earlier this month that led to the longest nationwide ground stop in 25 years — are rattling air travelers. Bad weather is swirling around San Francisco and the East Coast. “You start to get a little anxious,” said Debra Birnbaum, a journalist who lives in Los Angeles. Birnbaum grew up in New York and planned to fly there Tuesday for Thanksgiving. She said she’s not an alarmist, but she still doesn’t feel like she fully understands the reasons for the […]...
